section.sectionSummaryBrief: Fulfilling mitzvos as if new each day affects the unification of Sovev and Memaleh.
section.t: And it can be said,
that this—that the fulfillment of the mitzvos must be in a manner of truly as new ones—is not only so that through this the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos will be with greater vitality,
but rather
(also)
this matter itself
(that each day they should be in your eyes as new ones)
pertains to the fulfillment of the mitzvos.
For the matter of the mitzvos is that through them is effected the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
the unification of Sovev and Memaleh.
And since the service of man
(the arousal from below)
through which the drawing down is effected
(the arousal from above)
must be commensurate with the drawing down,
therefore, when the fulfillment of the mitzvos of man is in a manner that each day they are in his eyes as new ones,
a connection of time with that which is above time,
through this there is added in the revelation of the unification of Sovev and Memaleh that is effected through the mitzvos.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The two aspects of Sovev and Memaleh correspond to the names Havayah and Elokim, and their unification ensures that bodily matters are secondary to the soul.
section.t: And behold, the two matters of Sovev and Memaleh are the two names Havayah and Elokim.
And as is explained in many places,
that the name Elokim is not only the shield and sheath that conceals and hides the light of the name Havayah,
but rather also the light of the name Havayah as it is drawn down and contracted through the name Elokim to become a source for created beings,
which in general is the light of Memaleh,
is called Elokim.
And according to the known principle
that the fact that the body conceals the soul is because the source of the soul is from Havayah and the source of the body is from Elokim,
and therefore just as Elokim conceals Havayah, so too the body conceals the soul,
it can be said,
that similarly it is also regarding the matter of Sovev and Memaleh
[that also the light of Memaleh is called Elokim,
as above],
that in order for man to know and feel that the main thing is the matters of the soul and the matters of the body are only secondary,
it is through the unification of Sovev and Memaleh.
For in the light of Memaleh
(as it is in itself)
—since it is a source for created beings and the created beings occupy place relative to it—
there is a place-occupancy for matters of the body,
and through the unification of Sovev and Memaleh,
that also in the light as it becomes a source for worlds, the revelation of the Ein Sof light that is above worlds shines,
for everything before Him is considered as nothing,
through this there is the recognition that matters of the body are only for the sake of the soul.

And based on this, it is possible to explain what is said in Likkutei Torah, that when the matter of "each day as new ones" is not present, then his bitterness and delight are from matters of this world,
because in order for there to be the unification of Sovev and Memaleh,
through which matters of this world do not occupy place for him,
it is through his fulfillment of the mitzvos being in a manner of "each day as new ones."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Forgetfulness stems from limitation, and when mitzvah observance is limited it causes forgetfulness above and exile of the Shechinah.
section.t: And based on this, it is possible to explain the connection of exile to forgetfulness,
as it is written,
"Why do You forget us forever,"
for the cause of forgetfulness is that the knowledge that was with him previously was limited,
and therefore over the course of time it ceases.
And from this it is understood regarding the matter of memory and forgetfulness
(as it were)
above,
that the matter of memory is in Sovev,
for since it is without limit,
cessation does not apply there,
and the matter of forgetfulness is in Malchus,
for Malchus is the source of created beings,
Memaleh.
Therefore,
when the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos of man is in a manner of "each day they are as new ones,"
through which the revelation of the light of the Unlimited shines also in the limited light,
the matter of forgetfulness does not apply,
but when the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos of man is in limitation,
then,
when he fulfills that same mitzvah a second and third time, he does not have the same vitality as he had the first time,
which causes also above that in the limited light there will not be the revelation of the light of the Unlimited,
from this the matter of forgetfulness is drawn.
And just as in man,
when his fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos is in a manner of limitation,
it results from this that his delight is in matters of this world,
and this
(delight in matters of this world,
even in permitted desires)
is the opposite of holiness,
so too is it above,
that through Zeir Anpin
(Sovev)
departing,
the Holy One, blessed be He, ascends above,
and only Malchus remains
(Memaleh),
this causes a descent of Malchus to sustain the kelipos,
the exile of the Shechinah.
